title: Agora launches AUSD
description: Agora introduced AUSD as a USD-referenced stablecoin backed by its segregated reserve framework.
notes: Exact day-level launch date remains unresolved.

title: BitGo and World Liberty Financial introduce USD1
description: USD1 entered circulation in 2025 under a structure in which BitGo issues and redeems the token while World Liberty Financial owns the brand.
notes: The launch year is established; this record does not assert an unsupported day-level date.

title: Ethena launches USDtb
description: Ethena launched USDtb on December 16, 2024 with tokenized U.S. Treasury fund products and a stablecoin liquidity reserve as backing. The date is supported by Ethena’s official launch page and Curve’s contemporaneous dated launch publication.
notes: Launch-date Batch P resolves the previous null date using the official launch page and dated ecosystem publication.

title: Mountain Protocol advances USDM to Phase 3 wind-down
description: Mountain Protocol ended normal issuer-platform redemption and moved the remaining USDM reserve and exit process into its Phase 3 on-chain wind-down structure.
notes: Final token termination date remains unresolved.

title: Quantoz launches USDQ
description: Quantoz Payments announced USDQ as a U.S.-dollar electronic-money token issued initially on Ethereum under its Dutch electronic-money institution framework.
notes: Launch announcement date is recorded from the official Quantoz statement.
